boundedHeapOneShot.outcome: heap exhaustion while growing retained result arrays
boundedHeapOneShot.source: independently reproduced prerequisite review handoff for PR #145

diagnosis.primaryCause: trapezoidal nonlinear history recomputed G(current iteration) * x(previous), creating a repeating grow/fail/cut cycle and picosecond accepted timesteps
diagnosis.retention: one-shot result arrays retained every accepted point and amplified the unbounded point-growth failure; after bounding point growth, the complete retained result remains below 274 MiB RSS without decimation
diagnosis.fix: after 1024 accumulated trapezoidal Newton retries, switch the remaining run to Gear-2, clear trapezoidal history, and retry without dropping output points

commands.streamProfile: pnpm -C packages/core build && MAX_POINTS=1000000 pnpm exec tsx benchmarks/issue-146-memory.ts --stream
commands.oneShotProfile: pnpm -C packages/core build && /usr/bin/time -l pnpm exec tsx benchmarks/issue-146-memory.ts --one-shot
commands.parity: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm exec tsx benchmarks/issue-146-jimi-fuzz.ts --output benchmarks/results/issue-146/jimi-fuzz-after.json
